name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.134 is out (released 16:37 UTC). It has three changes: (1) Faster start: the app no longer parses multi-megabyte files (like the 8 MB bets file) on its main thread, which should cut the slow first open. (2) No more large-file rewrites: the JSON stores are no longer rewritten whole, which was a cause of lag. (3) Star ratings: the star-evidence table was refreshed from the 11-16 data. I haven't tested it on your phone. After you update, send a diagnostics report so I can check the cold-start time. If it's still slow, I'll cut more from startup.
